No Marp references anywhere in the generator either. I now have a complete picture of the problem. Here is my report.

---

## Findings: Marp Talk Routing Bug

### Root Cause

The Marp slide routing bug has **two compounding causes** -- both in the generator and in the reader. There is **zero support for `.marp` files** anywhere in the codebase. The `.marp` extension is not recognized by any component in the pipeline.

### Detailed Trace

#### 1. Generator: `buildTalk` sets route to empty string when no PDF exists

File: `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\course-builder.ts`, lines 30-37:

```js
function buildTalk(lo: Lo, lr: LearningResource) {
  const talk = lo as Talk;
  talk.pdf = getPdf(lr);        // returns "" -- no .pdf file in folder
  talk.pdfFile = getPdfFile(lr); // returns "" -- no .pdf file in folder
  if (!talk.pdf) {
    talk.route = lo.video;       // lo.video is also "" -- no videoid file
  }
}
```

The `talk-marp` folder at `D:\code\tutors-reference-course\topic-11-new-content-types\unit-2\talk-marp` contains only:
- `talk-marp.md` (metadata: title "Marp Slides" and summary)
- `talk-marp.marp` (the actual Marp markdown slides)

There is no `.pdf` file and no `videoid` file. So:
- `getPdf()` (in `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\utils\lr-utils.ts`, lines 144-150) searches for files with extension `"pdf"` -- finds nothing, returns `""`.
- `getVideo()` (same file, lines 157-168) requires a non-empty video ID -- returns `""`.
- `buildTalk` then sets `talk.route = lo.video = ""`.

The original route from `buildDefaultLo` (which would be `/talk/{{COURSEURL}}/topic-11-new-content-types/unit-2/talk-marp`) is **overwritten** with an empty string.

#### 2. Reader: Empty route causes navigation loop

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\layout\Card.svelte`, line 35 and 152:

```js
const route = $derived(cardDetails.type === "video" ? cardDetails.video! : cardDetails.route);
// ...
<a href={route} {target}>
```

When `lo.route` is `""`, the `<a href="">` link resolves to the current page URL. Clicking the Marp talk card on a topic page navigates back to the same topic page -- the observed "loop back" behavior.

Additionally, even if routing worked, the reader has no Marp renderer. File `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkClient.svelte` delegates exclusively to either `TalkAdobe.svelte` or `TalkMozilla.svelte`, both of which are PDF-only renderers:
- `TalkMozilla.svelte` uses `pdfjs-dist` to render `lo.pdf` as a PDF document
- `TalkAdobe.svelte` uses the Adobe PDF Embed SDK to render `lo.pdf`

Neither component checks for or handles `.marp` content.

#### 3. The `.marp` file is not even copied to output

File: `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-model-lib\src\types\media-types.ts`, lines 26-43 defines `assetTypes`:

```
png, jpg, jpeg, gif, svg, ..., pdf, zip, html, htm, yaml, xls, xlsx, xlsm, csv, pkt, css, kt, json, java, py, js
```

The `.marp` extension is **not** in `assetTypes`. The `copyAssetFiles` function in `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\resource-builder.ts` (line 62) only copies files whose extension is in `assetTypes`. The `.marp` file would not be included in the generated output.

#### 4. Folder naming is correct

The folder is named `talk-marp`, which starts with `talk`. The `getLoType` function in `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\resource-builder.ts` (line 12) uses `findLastMatchingString` to match folder name segments against `loSignatures` (which includes `/talk`). Since `talk-marp` starts with `talk`, it correctly identifies as type `"talk"`. The naming convention is not the problem.

### Summary of Issues to Fix

1. **Generator `buildTalk` fallback logic** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\course-builder.ts`, line 34-36): When no PDF exists, it blindly sets `talk.route = lo.video`. It should either preserve the original route or handle `.marp` files as an alternative content source.

2. **No `.marp` file recognition in `getPdf` or a new `getMarp` function** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\utils\lr-utils.ts`): There needs to be a way to detect `.marp` files and store their content or URL on the Talk object.

3. **The Talk type definition** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-model-lib\src\types\learning-objects.ts`, lines 72-76) only has `pdf` and `pdfFile` fields. It needs something like a `marp` or `contentType` field to distinguish Marp from PDF talks.

4. **Asset types** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-model-lib\src\types\media-types.ts`): `.marp` is not in `assetTypes`, so the file is never copied to the output.

5. **Reader `TalkClient.svelte`** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkClient.svelte`): Has no branch for rendering Marp content. A Marp renderer component would need to be created that parses the Marp markdown and renders slides (either by converting to HTML client-side using a library like `@marp-team/marp-core`, or by pre-rendering during generation).

## Findings: Marp Talk Routing Bug

### Root Cause

The Marp slide routing bug has **two compounding causes** -- both in the generator and in the reader. There is **zero support for `.marp` files** anywhere in the codebase. The `.marp` extension is not recognized by any component in the pipeline.

### Detailed Trace

#### 1. Generator: `buildTalk` sets route to empty string when no PDF exists

File: `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\course-builder.ts`, lines 30-37:

```js
function buildTalk(lo: Lo, lr: LearningResource) {
  const talk = lo as Talk;
  talk.pdf = getPdf(lr);        // returns "" -- no .pdf file in folder
  talk.pdfFile = getPdfFile(lr); // returns "" -- no .pdf file in folder
  if (!talk.pdf) {
    talk.route = lo.video;       // lo.video is also "" -- no videoid file
  }
}
```

The `talk-marp` folder at `D:\code\tutors-reference-course\topic-11-new-content-types\unit-2\talk-marp` contains only:
- `talk-marp.md` (metadata: title "Marp Slides" and summary)
- `talk-marp.marp` (the actual Marp markdown slides)

There is no `.pdf` file and no `videoid` file. So:
- `getPdf()` (in `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\utils\lr-utils.ts`, lines 144-150) searches for files with extension `"pdf"` -- finds nothing, returns `""`.
- `getVideo()` (same file, lines 157-168) requires a non-empty video ID -- returns `""`.
- `buildTalk` then sets `talk.route = lo.video = ""`.

The original route from `buildDefaultLo` (which would be `/talk/{{COURSEURL}}/topic-11-new-content-types/unit-2/talk-marp`) is **overwritten** with an empty string.

#### 2. Reader: Empty route causes navigation loop

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\layout\Card.svelte`, line 35 and 152:

```js
const route = $derived(cardDetails.type === "video" ? cardDetails.video! : cardDetails.route);
// ...
<a href={route} {target}>
```

When `lo.route` is `""`, the `<a href="">` link resolves to the current page URL. Clicking the Marp talk card on a topic page navigates back to the same topic page -- the observed "loop back" behavior.

Additionally, even if routing worked, the reader has no Marp renderer. File `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkClient.svelte` delegates exclusively to either `TalkAdobe.svelte` or `TalkMozilla.svelte`, both of which are PDF-only renderers:
- `TalkMozilla.svelte` uses `pdfjs-dist` to render `lo.pdf` as a PDF document
- `TalkAdobe.svelte` uses the Adobe PDF Embed SDK to render `lo.pdf`

Neither component checks for or handles `.marp` content.

#### 3. The `.marp` file is not even copied to output

File: `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-model-lib\src\types\media-types.ts`, lines 26-43 defines `assetTypes`:

```
png, jpg, jpeg, gif, svg, ..., pdf, zip, html, htm, yaml, xls, xlsx, xlsm, csv, pkt, css, kt, json, java, py, js
```

The `.marp` extension is **not** in `assetTypes`. The `copyAssetFiles` function in `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\resource-builder.ts` (line 62) only copies files whose extension is in `assetTypes`. The `.marp` file would not be included in the generated output.

#### 4. Folder naming is correct

The folder is named `talk-marp`, which starts with `talk`. The `getLoType` function in `D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\resource-builder.ts` (line 12) uses `findLastMatchingString` to match folder name segments against `loSignatures` (which includes `/talk`). Since `talk-marp` starts with `talk`, it correctly identifies as type `"talk"`. The naming convention is not the problem.

### Summary of Issues to Fix

1. **Generator `buildTalk` fallback logic** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\services\course-builder.ts`, line 34-36): When no PDF exists, it blindly sets `talk.route = lo.video`. It should either preserve the original route or handle `.marp` files as an alternative content source.

2. **No `.marp` file recognition in `getPdf` or a new `getMarp` function** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-gen-lib\src\utils\lr-utils.ts`): There needs to be a way to detect `.marp` files and store their content or URL on the Talk object.

3. **The Talk type definition** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-model-lib\src\types\learning-objects.ts`, lines 72-76) only has `pdf` and `pdfFile` fields. It needs something like a `marp` or `contentType` field to distinguish Marp from PDF talks.

4. **Asset types** (`D:\code\tutors-generator\cli\tutors-model-lib\src\types\media-types.ts`): `.marp` is not in `assetTypes`, so the file is never copied to the output.

5. **Reader `TalkClient.svelte`** (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\learning-objects\content\TalkClient.svelte`): Has no branch for rendering Marp content. A Marp renderer component would need to be created that parses the Marp markdown and renders slides (either by converting to HTML client-side using a library like `@marp-team/marp-core`, or by pre-rendering during generation).
